save.text: Sam absent tonight; Scanlan role will be handled by Keyleth and Percy; Pike absent (in New York); Patrick Rothfuss joining via Skype.
Loot Crate is sponsor; January theme 'origins'; order cutoff 9PM tonight; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off at lootcrate.com/criticalrole.
Blue Microphones provided audio gear; bluemic.com mentioned as vendor site.
Vox Machina fought Chroma Conclave; defeated Thordak; Raishan escaped with Thordak's corpse and two eggs; Raishan's location scryed to a southern Lucidian Ocean island (former Thordak lair/Opash's).
Characters rested fully; regained HP, half spent hit dice, spells recovered; Scanlan, Percy, and Pike leveled. (Pike offered choice of 8th-level cleric spells.)

Magic items distributed/inspected: Boots (returned to original owner requested), Dragonkilling sword discussed, Dwarven Thrower warhammer found: +3, thrown, returns, extra damage vs Giants, requires dwarf attunement.

Dwarven Thrower (warhammer) details: +3, thrown/returns, extra vs Giants, requires dwarf attunement; can be attuned if wearing Belt of Dwarvenkind (must remain attuned to belt or hammer unattunes). Damage die is d8 (not d12). Range: thrown 20/60 (beyond 20ft disadvantage on attack).

Boots of Elvenkind found; do not require attunement. If equipped, they replace Pike's Sprinter's Boots (which do require attunement). Swapping attuned boots is not an instant action—Matt cautioned it takes time and may be impractical in combat.
Deathwalker's Ward attunement set to necrotic by Percy (player declared).
Grog pulled cursed scimitar causing severe headache; curse expended leaving permanent -2 to all Grog's saving throws (Matt corrected earlier card error).
The scimitar's visible imagery: female-like face with fanged teeth and swirling snakes; blade immediately rusted to inert metal when dropped.
Pike (Laura) offered to attempt Greater Restoration (5th-level) to remove curse/headache; Pike unsure of curse nature; group discussed seeking a god (Raven Queen/Sarenrae) if needed.
Pike cast 5th-level Greater Restoration on Grog to remove curse/headache; spell failed—headache remains. (turn 245)
Taliesin (Vax) lost Ring of Lightning Resistance card—player reports it vanished. (turn 250)

Party loans gear to Kerrek/Patrick Rothfuss NPC: Cloak of Displacement placed on him; Ring of Invisibility loaned to him (with promise to return after dragon). Kerrek wears chainmail; cloak can go over armor. (turns 259-276, 263-269)

Party considering using scrying vs teleport/Transport via Plants on Opash's cave; Marisha notes potential risk of tipping off target because creatures with see invisibility can see the scrying sensor; decision leans toward teleport/Transport via Plants to avoid alerting Raishan/Opash. Kima/Allura offer to accompany; Kima takes a Gate Stone to give to Cassandra for safekeeping.
Grog collected three quartz-like 'salt lick' rocks (one palm-sized, one basketball-sized); placed in Bag of Holding.
Allura appears hardened/darkened, wearing ceremonial robes with runes on staff and extra rings; Kima arrives fully armored and will carry a Gate Stone to Cassandra.
Kima takes Gate Stone to give to Cassandra for safekeeping; when Kima returns guest (Allura) will be present; Keyleth to lead group to Sun Tree to teleport to island near Opash's lab.
Elven Boots (quiet) given to Kima; Kima removes lower armor to wear them; boots make her disappointed about appearance but accepts; Pass Without a Trace cast before portal use.

Sun Tree portal led to partially ruined jungle with radial blighted area centered on mountain/lab; party notes blight intensifies toward summit; group emerges ~quarter-mile from mountain top sighting.
Forest blight around Opash's mountain is centuries-old; trees near-petrified, no recent scarring observed. (turns 489–503)
No dragon tracks found near the Sun Tree landing; only small indigenous wildlife tracks. (turns 511–523)

Opash was a necromantic researcher from the Age of Arcanum; his island lair displaced/killed indigenous people; island considered cursed; Allura researched and reported these history notes. (turns 495–524)
Grog collected three quartz-like 'salt lick' rocks; one thrown into hollow-earth patch and sank, leaving a hole (demonstrating instability).
Forest blight around Opash's mountain shows hollow-earth sinkhole patches—unstable magical ground in 10–15 ft oval areas increasing toward summit; test rock sank revealing void.
Sun Tree portal led to partially ruined jungle with radial blighted area centered on mountain/lab; party emerges ~quarter-mile from mountain top; no dragon tracks found near landing.

Sun Tree portal led to partially ruined jungle with radial blighted area centered on mountain/lab; party emerges ~quarter-mile from mountain top; no dragon tracks found near landing; approaching mountain reveals a large boulder (20–30 ft) jammed in entranceway ~200 ft from landing. (turns 432, 620)

Boulder shows clustered holes pierced by very large dragon-sized claws; boulder has been placed/removed repeatedly over years. Party suspects heavy, likely immovable without effort; Perception/Investigation checks confirm. (turns 620, 640)

Party considers Stone Shape to thin seam of boulder to create an entry crack; Marisha volunteers limited carving; discussion of scrying interior vs entering—scrying considered. Recon around mountain would take ~1.5–2 hours by flying. (turns 645–669)
Scanlan role handled by Keyleth and Percy tonight; Patrick Rothfuss present via Skype and used Divine Sense. (turns 671–682)

Detect Dragons/Primeval Awareness used: three dragon life forces sensed roughly toward the mountain and below within one mile; spells' duration/range discussed (Laura confirmed within one mile). (turns 681–692, 683)
Grog found a 'Parapet of Wound Closure' item; offers to trade it to Vex without attunement; Grog promised not to activate/pull items and gave his deck/cards pouch to Vex. (turns 715–745)
Keyleth used Stone Shape to create a small tunnel opening (~5 ft max); she peeked through with Darkvision but rolled a 1 and saw only darkness. (turn 752–796)

Vex fired an Oracle Arrow (natural 20) through the hole; arrow lodged ~100 ft in at a leftward-descending curve; area beyond is pitch-black, undisturbed dust, no tracks or movement observed. (turns 798–801)

Group discussed noise risk: Raishan likely has good hearing; options: finish tunnel with another Stone Shape, Grog to force entry, or other stealth measures; Keyleth offered to cast another 4th-level spell as worst-case. (turns 812–822)
Oil of Etherealness available; Percy carries a small amount insufficient to cover him, could be used by Scanlan or Pike to go ethereal for an hour. (turn 823–861)
Fingerholds present on boulder—big, dragon-sized fingerholds indicating it was jammed in place; investigation check 17 found no switches. (turns 866–868)

Party considering mechanical solutions: lever using Kima's sword as a pry, Grog to physically assault/lever the rock; concerns about damaging Kima's Holy Avenger ('You ding it, you pay'). Bigby-level magic considered but avoided. (turns 870–892)
Group wedged the sword with Immovable Rods (each holds 8,000 lb); rods currently jammed in finger-holes holding boulder/door partly open but slowly moving. Grog pulled ~1.5 ft. (turns 894–921).

Party entered 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall carved tunnel; air still, smell of rot/stagnant water; floor dusted and contains scattered light porous shards — identified as charred bone fragments. (turns 932–947).
Sun Tree scrying earlier indicated distance <1 mile from surface to lab/tunnels but vision was disorienting/fast; Keyleth couldn't give detailed tunnel layout. (turns 950–956).

Forest blight around Opash's mountain shows hollow-earth sinkhole patches—unstable magical ground in 10–15 ft oval areas increasing toward summit; test rock sank revealing void. (confirmed via nature/observation while approaching mountain tunnel).
Party made stealth checks while moving through curving tunnel; most succeeded (results: 30,35,34,30,28,25/30,18,29). (turns 965–975)
Pike cast Death Ward (4th-level) on Vex; effect lasts eight hours. (turns 991–999)

Tunnel exploration: shelves/alcoves every ~20 ft with candles, skulls, small books, wooden box (untrapped) and mummified raccoon; dagger emitting light allows 60 ft vision for Liam; without it darkvision ~15 ft. Party proceeding stealthily; perception/investigation checks noted (Liam 29, 22, 22).
Kerrek (Grog) physically grabbed/embraced party member while moving in darkness (heavy footfalls noted).
Players discussed using light vs darkness; dagger emits flame (~15 ft illumination in darkness for general, 60 ft for Liam with dagger out).
Kerrek (Percy) used Divine Sense and detected an undead presence nearby, originating from the left/wall area of the tunnel; not powerful or directional beyond 'left'.

Grog found a dust-covered, slightly singed human skull on a shelf with two mostly melted candles; Kerrek confirmed undead presence near that skull; Grog picked up the skull and handed it to Kerrek. (skull may act as watcher/trigger; Kerrek made Religion check ~12.)
Kerr/party found human skull radiating undead energy; Divine Sense confirmed skull as undead source but inactive. Kerr stuffed skull in burlap sack and positioned it facing wall. (turns 1164–1191)

Party entered new hexagonal chamber ~25 ft high with central dark-green marble pillar topped by an iron bowl/dais ~5–6 ft high; off to right: large leather-bound tome and an unlit cold iron brazier with tinder/ingredients. No undead detected within 60 ft by Divine Sense. (turns 1199–1210,1230)
Revised: Sam absent tonight; Scanlan role handled by Keyleth and Percy; Pike absent (in New York); Patrick Rothfuss present/using Divine Sense this session. (turns 0,1164)

Chamber description: entering room with raised platform/pillar/iron bowl center; large iron door opposite; brazier and a singular leather tome on shelf to right. No visible ceiling exits or mechanical levers/pulleys—likely magical if door operates. (confirmed by Matt).
Bowl contains long-dried dark burgundy residue—scrapable powder; tastes iron-like (blood). Players discussed bleeding into bowl to open door. (turns 1262–1288)
Leather tome: large, no cover/spine text; appears old tough leather—uncertain if tanned hide or flesh. Grog moved to inspect. (turns 1296–1301)
Allura researched Opash/Island history; island cursed and displaced indigenous people. (confirmed earlier, Allura present.)

Book in lab resists reading: text shrinks/obscures as viewer focuses; radiant light (Patrick's hammer) makes pages go blank; in darkness someone with low-light vision might read it (party discussing extinguishing lights).
Allura appears hardened/darkened, wearing ceremonial robes with runes on staff and extra rings; Kima arrived armored with Gate Stone to give Cassandra. (unchanged)
Book in brazier was a booby-trapped explosive decoy; Allura called it 'well-played' after explosion destroyed the book. (turns 1372–1429)
Keyleth and Kerrek (Scanlan) failed save; Keyleth and Kerrek took 32 fire damage; others took 16 except rogue who took none. Book destroyed. (turns 1398–1411,1427)
Players attempted using dragon/basilisk blood on the sealed door mechanism; basilisk blood poured into bowl had no immediate effect; Vex cut her hand to add blood. (turns 1448–1450)

Basilisk blood in bowl reacts to party's blood; small drops sank beneath surface but didn't open door until more blood lost — when door opened basilisk blood burned away and party took 1 point damage. (Matt described sequence).

Flaming, floating skulls (undead) appeared and advanced down hallway toward party; Pike cast Holy Aura creating 30-ft radius protective radiant runes giving advantages/disadvantages as per spell; party rolled initiative. (turns 1479–1490,1498–1505)

Forest blight around Opash's mountain shows hollow-earth sinkhole patches—unstable magical ground in 10–15 ft oval areas increasing toward summit; test rock sank revealing void. (confirmed by observation during expedition; skulls/encounter occurred later near cavern).

Combat in cavern: skulls (flaming?), four total; Scanlan invisible and backed to northern wall (Scanlan held action/invisibility). Vax positioned on opposite wall 10 ft in air; Vax hit two skulls with Whisper and venom dagger (19 and 10 dmg). Keyleth cast Moonbeam (5-ft radius, concentration, up to 1 min) hitting two skulls; both failed Con saves and took 13 radiant each. Turn ordering: Scanlan and Vax went first. Pike rolled a 9; Kerrek rolled a 1. (turns 1516–1587)
Description: Skull targets show flames wreathing around them; one damaged skull's flames subdued by Moonbeam and nearly fell. No one has moved onto the carpet yet. (turns 1558,1586–1589)

During combat in Opash's lab area, four flame skulls each cast Fireball via red jaw beams, causing four simultaneous explosions; Scanlan unaffected; all others made four Dexterity saves with advantage. (turns 1595–1609,1612–1624,1627–1635)

Damage results from the four Fireballs: Keyleth, Vax, and Vex saved all and took 56 fire damage each; Percy saved all and took 56; Scanlan took 0 via Evasion; Grog failed two and took 72 (later clarified as 48 then 72; final given 72 then 70/88 confusion—Matt settled on 88 for some contexts) but final noted as 76/72 inconsistently—Grog reported taking 76 earlier then Matt corrected to 72; Pike failed two and with fire resistance took 44; Trinket saved against one. (turns 1639–1679)

Players confused over exact numeric totals during damage adjudication; Matt simplified several totals (e.g., Percy 56, Keyleth/Vex 56, Pike 44). Players confirmed current HPs: Keyleth at 50 HP; Vex at 57 HP. (turns 1644–1676)
During current combat: Keyleth/party in kill-box; Percy (Vox) used Animus and sharpshooter, killed multiple skull-enemies; Keyleth provided cover/positioning. (turns 1686–1719)

Patrick Rothfuss (Allura) declared his Aura of Divinity grants +3 to saving throws for allies within aura; Matt confirmed it would have affected saves (e.g., Pike, Grog) and retroactively reduces one instance of fire damage by 11. (turns 1722–1731)

Grog's earlier failed saves: with +3 aura some failures would have become successes—Matt noted Grog rolled tens and 21s; the aura would have changed a 10 to 13 making that save succeed; total damage avoided recalculated (Matt: would've been 56 before?). Discussion clarified saves vs attacks. (turns 1735–1742)
